# Bureau After Dark raster assets

Mode: built-in image_gen.imagegen. Four new images; one call per asset; no retries or variants. No input reference images.

## night-garden.png

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape collectible-card illustration for the mystery game Bureau After Dark, 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: a richly beautiful moonlit secret garden with luminous silver flowers and a misty winding path.
Style/medium: highly polished magical storybook gouache painting, graceful detailed botanical forms, painterly paper texture, premium collectible illustration.
Composition/framing: central full-bleed magical garden subject; immersive landscape, no frame. Flowers and moonlit path are a rich magical payoff much brighter than the surroundings.
Lighting/mood: quiet mysterious moonlight, luminous silver blooms, drifting mist, inviting wonder.
Color palette: deep indigo, nocturnal teal, silver, restrained antique gold.
Constraints: no people, no text, no letters, no card frame, no borders, no UI, no watermark.

## bureau-objects.png

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: genuinely transparent square game furniture sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 objects total.
Primary request: polished illustrated midnight Bureau furniture in indigo upholstery, warm aged wood and antique brass.
Composition/framing: EXACT 4x4 equal-cell atlas on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Each of the sixteen equal cells contains exactly ONE complete centered object with at least 15% empty transparent padding on every side. There must be no grid lines; the invisible grid is only placement. Distinct complete silhouettes, all parts fully contained within their own cell, no clipping, no overlap.
Viewpoint: consistent slightly elevated top-down game view, mostly top surface visible and only a subtle front edge, not frontal showroom photography.
Object order, left to right:
Row 0: quiet upholstered alcove reading chair; reading desk with neutral blank papers; brass drawer chest; paper sorting tray.
Row 1: arched wall niche cabinet; low wood cabinet; tall arched high window; empty glass specimen case with NO shell or specimen inside.
Row 2: plain display stand; stone bench; closed plum velvet box; closed leather ledger.
Row 3: wide horizontal bookcase with 230:65 footprint aspect ratio; sealed ornate archive cabinet; brass elevator doors seen top-down-ish; small brass wall lamp.
Style/medium: refined painted gouache game sprites, crisp readable contours, restrained material detail, consistent moonlit indigo/wood/brass palette.
Constraints: REAL PNG transparency with alpha=0 in all empty areas, NOT a checkerboard painting, NOT a white or colored backdrop. No ground plane, no floor. No hidden sigils, icons, answers, letters, labels, text, grid lines, watermark. Exactly sixteen sprites only, in this exact order.
